verdict.rationale: cubic documents a one-click "Fix with cubic" action on review findings. Its coding agent then generates the fix and pushes it to the PR branch, so the core outcome of applying a reviewer's fix with one click is delivered. However, the evidence never shows the suggested diff appearing inside the review comment for inspection before committing (e.g., a GitHub suggestion block); the fix is generated after the click. Missing for 10: evidence of inline committable suggestion diffs shown in comments, preview of the change before applying, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click

citations.quote: When the AI spots a problem, you can click the **Fix with cubic** button
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
